snippets.snippet_text: "Amazon Handmade enables a reach of 300 million potential customers while Etsy covers 'only' 90 million. Amazon's fees are high (15% referral on each sale) and the in-house regulations when it comes to marketing your products are stricter. Etsy ($0.20 per item) tends to be more economical and offers you more freedom when it comes to branding."
